label: Finding-34
title: scale-2.6m-hosts: 'of which' joins two different counters
description: The 2.6 million is VulnCheck's count; the 1.57 million unpatched is Censys's, out of the 2.58 million hosts Censys saw on 21 October (SecurityWeek). The same 'of which' framing recurs in questions.json and readings.json. Suggested wording: 'VulnCheck counts about 2.6 million; Censys saw 2.58 million on 21 October, of which 1.57 million were unpatched.'

comments.author: cli-user
comments.text: Run-3: Fixed in v0.13.0: VulnCheck's 2.6 million and Censys's 1.57 of 1.58 million are now separate counters.
